versions.changelog:
Version 1.8.0 — Structure and documentation updates

- Moved detailed metrics definitions to a new reference file (`references/metrics-dimensions.md`) for context efficiency.
- Simplified and updated SKILL.md to reference the metrics file instead of duplicating indicator definitions.
- Improved metadata fields; added explicit display name, version, categories, format requirements, references, and usage trigger details.
- Removed redundant or duplicate document (`skill-card.md`).
- Kept the metric report template and usage scenarios for quick reference.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md version to 1.7.0.
- No significant content changes detected in SKILL.md aside from version bump and minor metadata update.

- Added slug and displayName fields for better metadata and display integration.
- Updated version to 1.6.3.
- No changes to metrics structure or usage guidance.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file for simplification.

- Added new related downstream skills: qa-stakeholder-communication, qa-tech-debt-management, and qa-test-reporting.
- Introduced categories metadata (Development, Testing, DevOps).
- Enhanced output format: each metric report now includes a unique traceability ID (METRIC-XXXX).
- Specified quantification depth requirements and minimum coverage for all four metric types.
- Added error recovery guidance for cases of missing or incomplete data.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Version 1.5.0

- Updated skill description for greater clarity on when and why to use the skill, emphasizing actionable insights.
- Added a "version" field to the metadata.
- Restructured input and output formats: detailed required and optional inputs, and more clearly specified structured outputs.
- Clarified degree indicators and retained practical reporting templates and checklists.
- Removed the file "skill-card.md" for streamlined documentation.
- Minor refinements to terminology and examples, ensuring a focus on quality trends and problem discovery.

- Description simplified to clarify four quality metric dimensions and trigger scenarios.
- Removed redundant wording and condensed the wording in the description.
- No content or structure changes in metric definitions or templates.
- Deleted the skill-card.md file.

qa-quality-metrics 1.4.0

- Expanded skill to cover more business scenarios, including management reporting and trend analysis.
- Enhanced description with additional activation keywords and real-world examples.
- Replaced upstream related skill from qa-defect-lifecycle to qa-bug-lifecycle.
- Added usage examples and refined guidance for building reports.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

Version 1.3.0

- 全面升级文档，系统梳理四类质量度量（过程、结果、效率、健康）。
- 明确度量指标、计算方式与典型目标值，覆盖测试与质量各环节。
- 提供标准化报告模板和验收清单，便于衡量与落地改进。
- 增加与上下游关联技能说明，明确输入输出数据链路。
